decisionsTitle: One volunteer badge for everyone, without roles, is the default
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-15:** «aș vrea să am un singur ecuson de voluntari, fără roluri». It amends §764 (the volunteer badges, printed per role on the role's coloured band) and §776 (the free-text line and the marker area).

**Decision.**

- **A choice in «Cum arată ecusonul»**, the house `RadioField` and never a toggle, in a section of its own that comes first because it decides what the others mean: «Un singur ecuson pentru toți, fără rol» (`mode: single`) and «Câte un ecuson pe rol» (`mode: perRole`, §764 kept as it was). **`single` is the default** — for a design that never chose and so for every design saved before the choice existed (the owner's ask: an existing event's badges now print as one badge until the club chooses the roles). It is read forgivingly like every key of the design: a missing, unknown or wrong-typed value reads `single` and the designer says the stored one could not be read (§776's note). No migration: the two new keys live in the `events.badge_design` JSON, travel in the event's file and in a copy, and an old file reads as before.
- **The one badge** is the badge «fără rol» of §764 made the main way: the club's own typed «VOLUNTAR» / «VOLUNTEER» alone and large on the band, no role's name anywhere, and no personal data. Its **band colour** (`singleColour`) is chosen like a role's — the club's orange, one of the six colours of the numbers' palette that carry their words at AA, or a typed `#rrggbb` after «Altă culoare» — through the same `RoleColourFields`, the same help with the limits said in words (a hash and six digits; white or black text must read on it, contrast 4.5 to 1), and the same state in words with the contrast (`RoleColourSample`), never by colour alone. The typed box shows only while «Altă culoare» is chosen, so the select alone decides which colour is meant (`OnlyWhenChosen` now also reads a native select). A typed text that is no colour is refused naming its box; a colour no word reads on is `BADGE_COLOUR_UNREADABLE`; a stored one no word reads on prints the club's orange. Only while the one badge is chosen: with the badges per role the box is hidden and its unusable colour is saved as the club's orange, never refused. The palette's green does not carry its words at AA and is never offered. In `perRole` mode the badges «fără rol» keep §764's orange whatever `singleColour` holds, so a design that goes back prints exactly as it did.
- **The count.** One «Câte ecusoane» and «În plus» for the single pile. «Câte ecusoane» starts at the event's **confirmed volunteers**; with none confirmed yet, at the **people its roles need together**; with no role asking for anyone, at **ten** — my decision, said in the card's own help line. The page reads only a count (`countConfirmedVolunteers`), never a name, an address or a telephone. The whole pile is everyone, so each box takes up to a file's worth (1 000), not the 300 of a role's pile; the total ceiling and the refusal back to the page are §764's. The route reads `all` and `allx` in this mode and ignores the roles' boxes and «Ecusoane fără rol».
- **The sheet and the picture** are the same: one pile with no role through the ONE geometry (`badge-geometry.ts`) — N plus the spares packed on A4 with the cut marks — and the free-text line and the marker area of §776 stay (the marker area is where a role can still be written by hand; its label stays the club's choice). The preview route draws no role while the design is `single`, whichever role the address names, so flipping the radio redraws the sample at once.
- **The telephone.** The one badge has no category to take §774's default number from, so «Telefon coordonator» ticked needs the number typed there (refused naming the box otherwise), and a stored design ticked with no number draws no blank row on the one badge (`badgePhoneRow`). The badges per role keep §774.
- **Per-role mode unchanged**, §774's category phone default included. The roles' colour boxes stay in the role's form and in «Culorile rolurilor»; a one-line help under a role's own boxes says the colour serves the badge per role only, the card's intro and its closed line (“Doar pe roluri” while the one badge is chosen) say it on the badges' page.

**Refused:** a toggle button (the owner's standing rule: a choice is radios); a migration (the JSON column takes keys); hiding «Culorile rolurilor» while the one badge is chosen (the colours stay kept for the day the badges go per role); a second geometry or preview for the one badge.
changelogLine: - **One volunteer badge for everyone, without roles, is the default** — «Cum arată ecusonul» chooses between «Un singur ecuson pentru toți, fără rol» and «Câte un ecuson pe rol»; the one badge says the club's «VOLUNTAR» alone on a colour chosen in the designer (AA checked), «Câte ecusoane» starts at the confirmed volunteers, and the sheet packs N plus the spares; existing designs read as the one badge until the roles are chosen. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Cum arată ecusonul», then a choice of two radios, «Un singur ecuson pentru toți, fără rol» and «Câte un ecuson pe rol», is the first section, the one badge for everyone is the choice for a design that never chose and for every design stored before the choice, and a stored choice that is unknown or of the wrong type reads as the one badge, named in the designer beside its section — never a throw; the two keys travel in the event's file under `badges.design`, the diff naming each, and in a copy of the event (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badge-single.test.ts`, `volunteers/badges-page-render.test.ts`; integration `volunteers/badges.test.ts`; e2e `volunteer-badges.spec.ts`.

Given the one badge for everyone, then its band reads the club's typed «VOLUNTAR» / «VOLUNTEER» alone and large, no role's name appears on it, and its colour is the club's orange, a palette colour that carries its words at AA or a typed `#rrggbb` after «Altă culoare», told in words with the contrast; a typed text that is no colour is refused naming its box, a colour no word reads on is refused (`BADGE_COLOUR_UNREADABLE`), a stored one no word reads on prints the club's orange, and in the badges per role the badges «fără rol» keep the club's orange and a colour left hidden in the box, unreadable or no colour, never blocks the save (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badge-single.test.ts`; integration `volunteers/badges.test.ts`.

Given «Tipărire» with the one badge for everyone, when «Descarcă ecusoanele (PDF)» is pressed, then the PDF holds «Câte ecusoane» — by default the event's confirmed volunteers, else what its roles need together, else ten — plus «În plus» of that one badge, no role's box and no «Ecusoane fără rol» read, packed on as many A4 pages as they take through the one geometry, its properties naming how many badges it holds; a number that is not a whole number from 0 to 1 000, or a total past 1 000, is refused as §764's is; the page reads only how many volunteers are confirmed, never who (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badge-single.test.ts`; integration `volunteers/badges.test.ts`; e2e `volunteer-badges.spec.ts`.

Given a badge design that chooses the badges per role, then it draws, prints and counts exactly as §764 and §774 have it — a pile per role with its spares, the badges «fără rol» on the club's orange, the category's telephone when «Telefonul coordonatorului» is ticked with no number — the roles' colour boxes say in one line that they serve the badge per role only, and on the one badge the telephone ticked needs its number typed (2026-10-15, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `volunteers/badge-category-phone.test.ts`, `volunteers/badges-pdf.test.ts`; integration `volunteers/badges.test.ts`, `volunteers/badge-category-phone.test.ts`; e2e `volunteer-badges.spec.ts`.

batchLine: one volunteer badge for everyone, without roles
